Truck limits

Delivery window

Window = Last Drop Plan Date Start → Last Drop Plan Date End. Shift the start and/or end by + or − days below. A negative End (e.g. end −5) means the customer can take delivery that many days before the End date — the End stays the latest and the Start date is ignored. A load never ships before its pick date.
Standard (all customers) start end

Per‑customer overrides

A load whose customer name contains the text uses that row's window instead of the standard one.

Same‑location customers

Tell the map which customer names are the same delivery location. Put names (or parts of names) that mean the same place in one row, separated by commas — loads on the same TMS that match any name in the row are treated as one customer when grouping. Example: WAL-MART, WAL MART.

Same location (merge ZIPs)

For a delivery point that shows up under more than one ZIP (same name, different ZIPs — e.g. ADUSA DISTRIBUTION, LLC at 18017 and 18020), add the name and each ZIP here. On the Loads by DC load summary those will be counted and totaled as one location. Leave ZIPs blank to merge all ZIPs for that name.

Consolidated Locations

For each ship‑from origin, add delivery locations that consolidate well out of that shipper — one per box (location name on top, ZIP underneath), and use + Add location for more. Locations under the same origin are treated as a lane that can ship together. In Loads by DC, set Same destination = good consolidation lanes to group them — truck limits and delivery‑window rules still apply.
